About "No pork on my fork"

A lot of people in our community don't eat pork — for faith, for health, or just because that's how they were raised. We wanted to be honest about which items we serve are part of the all-beef line, instead of making people ask.

So you'll see a small stamp on those items: Vienna Beef hot dogs and Polish, our corned beef and pastrami. It's a product promise, item by item — not a slogan painted across the whole place. If we ever serve something with pork, we'll tell you that straight too.
